title: Steps Are Not Being Counted Properly
body:
I’ve been walking on the treadmill for almost 20 minutes, but my step count only increased from 3,500 to 3,800. That’s honestly ridiculous.

Even when I tried using my phone alone, it still didn’t accurately count my steps. I was literally walking on a treadmill the whole time, yet most of my steps weren’t recorded.

I needed to reach 5,000 steps to complete a task on another app, but because the steps weren’t counted properly, it feels like I walked for nothing.

Really disappointed with this device/app. The step tracking is extremely inaccurate and the Apple Watch connection is way too complicated. Hopefully this can be fixed soon.

title: Lack of Sharing Features in a Picture to other Social Media
body:
As an enthusiastic user of the Apple Watch Ultra and the Health app, I am writing to express my thoughts and suggestions regarding their current capabilities, particularly in comparison to other leading sports and fitness platforms like Garmin, Suunto, Polar, Coros, and Strava.

While I have enjoyed using my Apple Watch Ultra for tracking a variety of sports activities such as running, swimming, hiking, cycling, and golfing, I have been increasingly disappointed by the limited sharing capabilities of the Health app. The inability to share my activities beyond family members, doctors, or friend contacts in a visually appealing and engaging manner significantly diminishes the user experience.

Other platforms like Suunto, Strava, Garmin, Nike, and Adidas have excelled in allowing users to share their activity data through beautifully designed pictures that incorporate essential metrics like total distance, pace, cadence, heartbeat, weather conditions, and more. These images, often enhanced by a photo taken during the activity and prominently featuring the brand logo, serve as both personal achievements and powerful advertisements on social media.

It is surprising that even after nine years since the launch of the Apple Watch, and subsequent development of the Health app, Apple has not yet embraced this effective form of user engagement and brand promotion. The potential for users to share their sports activities with a sleek and iconic Apple logo would not only enhance user satisfaction but also provide Apple with organic, widespread visibility across social media platforms.

I strongly urge Apple to consider developing features that allow users to create and share visually appealing images of their sports activities, complete with key data and the Apple logo. This enhancement would position Apple on par with, if not ahead of, its competitors in terms of user experience and community engagement.

Thank you for your consideration. I am confident that with Apple’s innovative spirit and commitment to excellence, these improvements can be realized, greatly benefiting both users and the Apple brand.

title: Reminder & tracking
body:
Great app so far with rooms for improvement.

For instance, there is reminder & tracking for medication but non available for water.

The app have all the user’s data such as age, weight, height and so on, why not offer user the best experience ever? From the data, this app should be able to calculate and suggests to the user, plus with additional data of what is the daily activities/type of work, recommended  amount of water to drink daily accurately. 

Recommendations should also take the activities data real-time & constantly re-adjust it accordingly. I.e. users going for a hiking, biking (and other kind of sports) etc.

With data from Sleep Focus, recommendation should also include when (how frequent, hourly, hour and half, two hours etc) to drink, of course during users is awake.

To complete the minimum of 8 glasses (but not limited to) of water daily, reminders would be very helpful, just like the reminders for medication.

A pre-set amount of water intake per glass (based on amount recommended divide by 8 or more [user input] as option) would be even better. 

Looking forward for the app update.
